sources.description: The Denver Broncos selected Utah tight end Caleb Lohner with their 241st overall selection in the 7th round of the 2025 NFL Draft. However, this was not your ordinary 7th-round pick. Lohner is a former basketball player transitioning to football, and he played just one year of college football at Utah. He would be entering […]
